metadata.er-tech-spec: title: looply · 库存系统 实体关系图 version: v2.0 · 2026-05-11 tables: - name: inventory_unit comment: 库存单元 note: 库存管理最小单元，关联商品系统的 product；一物一码 quantity=1，标品 quantity≥1 columns: - name: unit_id comment: 库存单元ID constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: product_id comment: 实物商品ID constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: quantity comment: 库存数量 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: inventory_status comment: 库存状态 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: location_type comment: 位置类型 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: warehouse_id comment: 所在仓库 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: bin_code comment: 库位编码 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: transit_type comment: 在途类型 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: transit_ref_no comment: 在途关联单号 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: cost_price comment: 单位成本 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: currency comment: 成本币种 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: entered_at comment: 入库时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: last_moved_at comment: 最近移动时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: inventory_ledger comment: 库存流水 note: 每次库存变动记录一条流水，支持追溯和对账 columns: - name: ledger_id comment: 流水ID constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: unit_id comment: 库存单元ID constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: event_type comment: 事件类型 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: quantity_change comment: 数量变化 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: from_status comment: 变动前状态 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: to_status comment: 变动后状态 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: from_location comment: 变动前位置 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: to_location comment: 变动后位置 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: ref_type comment: 关联单据类型 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: ref_no comment: 关联单据号 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: operator_id comment: 操作人ID constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: operator_type comment: 操作人类型 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: occurred_at comment: 发生时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: remark comment: 备注 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: channel_inventory_allocation comment: 渠道库存分配 note: 记录库存单元在各渠道的分配，支持多渠道售卖和预占/锁定 columns: - name: allocation_id comment: 分配ID constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: unit_id comment: 库存单元ID constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: channel_id comment: 渠道ID constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: listing_id comment: 渠道商品ID constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: allocated_quantity comment: 分配数量 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: available_quantity comment: 可售数量 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: reserved_quantity comment: 预占数量 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: locked_quantity comment: 锁定数量 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: allocation_status comment: 分配状态 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: reserved_order_no comment: 预占订单号 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: reserved_at comment: 预占时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: reserve_expire_at comment: 预占过期时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: locked_at comment: 锁定时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: locked_reason comment: 锁定原因 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: activity_id comment: 活动ID constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: warehouse comment: 仓库 note: 仓库基础信息，支持多仓库管理 columns: - name: warehouse_id comment: 仓库ID constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: warehouse_code comment: 仓库编码 constraint: UNIQUE type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: warehouse_name comment: 仓库名称 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: warehouse_type comment: 仓库类型 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: market_id comment: 所属Market constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: country_code comment: 国家代码 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: state_code comment: 州/省代码 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: city comment: 城市 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: address comment: 详细地址 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: postal_code comment: 邮编 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: contact_name comment: 联系人 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: contact_phone comment: 联系电话 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: status comment: 状态 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: relations: - from: inventory_unit to: inventory_ledger type: 1:N label: 产生流水 color: '#E8833A' penwidth: 1.4 - from: inventory_unit to: channel_inventory_allocation type: 1:N label: 分配到渠道 color: '#8E24AA' penwidth: 1.4 - from: inventory_unit to: warehouse type: N:1 label: 所在仓库 color: '#43A047' - from: inventory_unit to: product type: N:1 label: 关联实物商品 style: dashed color: '#999999' - from: channel_inventory_allocation to: channel type: N:1 label: 所属渠道 style: dashed color: '#999999' - from: channel_inventory_allocation to: listing type: N:1 label: 关联渠道商品 style: dashed color: '#999999' - from: warehouse to: market type: N:1 label: 所属Market style: dashed color: '#999999' design_rules: 库存单元: inventory_unit 是库存管理最小单元，直接关联商品系统的 product；一物一码 quantity=1，标品 quantity≥1 三层架构: 仓内实物库存层（物理位置）→ 中央库存层（全盘资产）→ 渠道库存层（多渠道售卖） 流水台账: 每次库存变动记录一条 inventory_ledger 流水，quantity_change 记录数量变化（一物一码±1，标品±N） 多渠道售卖: 同一库存单元可分配到多渠道；一物一码下单时排他预占，标品按数量分配 渠道数量拆分: allocated_quantity = available_quantity + reserved_quantity + locked_quantity 预占超时释放: reserve_expire_at + 定时任务扫描，超时未支付自动释放预占数量 状态分离: inventory_status（物理流转）与商品系统的 item_status（业务生命周期）分离管理，事件驱动同步 分仓管理: 一个 product 可有多个 inventory_unit 分布在不同仓库，SUM(quantity) = product 总库存 外部引用: product/channel/listing/market 为商品系统和Market主数据的外部实体，虚线表示跨模块引用
